channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Europe, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Europe, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Fonds BJP Press Play 2027: Development Programme for Journalistic Makers (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
Fonds BJP (Fonds voor Bijzondere Journalistieke Projecten)
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 3,200 towards about 20 days of time invested, plus a personal coach and workshops. No application fee.

Press Play helps makers develop and pitch a journalistic or creative project, with five places in each of four tracks: audio, video, writing and photo.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Mondriaan Fund: Call for Proposals, Dutch Pavilion at the Venice Biennale Arte 2028 (EUR 500,000 presentation budget) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
Mondriaan Fund
Deadline: 1 Dec 2026, 16:00 CET
Award: EUR 500,000 (incl. VAT, excl. fees) presentation budget for the selected team; up to 4 shortlisted teams receive EUR 5,000 each to develop their plan.

The first open call for the Dutch entry to the Venice Biennale Arte since 2018, run by the Mondriaan Fund for the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: AFK Amsterdam Fund for the Arts: Project Subsidies 2026-2028 (closes 2 Dec)
item.description:
Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst (AFK)
Deadline: 2 Dec 2026, 15:00 CET
Award: Category 1: EUR 1,500 to 2,500; category 2: EUR 2,500 to 7,500; category 3: EUR 7,500 to 17,500 (includes artistic development, replacing the old stipend); category 4: EUR 17,500 and up. No application fee.

The general Amsterdam project grant for individuals, collectives and organisations living or working in Amsterdam or nearby municipalities, across disciplines including digital and media work.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Danish Arts Foundation (Statens Kunstfond): Production and Exhibitions, visual arts (1 January 2027 round) (closes 1 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Danish Arts Foundation (Statens Kunstfond)
Deadline: 1 Jan 2027, 14:00 CET
Award: No maximum stated; the committee may award less than requested. Covers production of new work, exhibition costs, promotion, and production and exhibition honoraria for the artist. No application fee.

The Danish Arts Foundation funds producing, showing and promoting contemporary visual art in Denmark and abroad.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: CNC Fonds d'aide au jeu video (FAJV), session of 18 January 2027 (France, games studios) (closes 18 Jan 2027)
item.description:
CNC (Centre national du cinema et de l'image animee)
Deadline: 18 Jan 2027
Award: No fixed figure: up to 100 percent of costs for writing, 50 percent for pre-production and production. The June 2026 session awarded EUR 10,000 per writing project, EUR 25,000 to 150,000 for pre-production and EUR 80,000 to 200,000 for production. No application fee.

France's FAJV gives selective grants for the writing, pre-production and production of video games, plus support for collective operations such as events. ELIGIBILITY: games companies established in France; suitable for studios, not individual artists.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Creative Europe MEDIA: Films on the Move 2027 (up to 90 percent of costs for sales agents coordinating cross-border film releases) (closes 21 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Creative Europe MEDIA (European Commission / EACEA)
Deadline: 21 Jan 2027, 17:00 CET
Award: Grant of up to 90 percent of total project costs with no fixed request limit; 70 percent prefinancing. Support passed on to distributors is capped per territory (for example EUR 150,000 in DE/FR/IT/ES and EUR 60,000 in AT/BE/NL/PL for films up to EUR 15 million; double for animation and bigger films). Total call budget EUR 23,500,000. No application fee.

Films on the Move (CREA-MEDIA-2027-FILMOVE) supports the cinema and online distribution of non-national European films across borders, and encourages subtitling, dubbing and audio description.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Fonds Darstellende Kuenste: Produktionsfoerderung, round 01/2027 (EUR 15,000 to 50,000 for independent performing arts) (closes 25 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Fonds Darstellende Kuenste
Deadline: 25 Jan 2027
Award: EUR 15,000 to 50,000 per production. At least 50 percent of the requested amount must already be approved from German municipal and/or state public funds. No application fee.

The federal fund for independent performing arts supports new productions by professional artists and ensembles based in Germany, with grants of EUR 15,000 to 50,000 per production.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Austria: Startstipendien for Film Art 2027 (BMWKMS) (closes 31 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Austrian Federal Ministry for Arts and Culture (BMWKMS)
Deadline: 31 Jan 2027
Award: Six grants of EUR 9,000, plus family supplements of EUR 200 to 400 per month. No application fee.

Start-up grants for emerging filmmakers to develop a feature-length fiction, documentary, hybrid, animated or experimental project, with a mandatory companion programme.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Austria: Startstipendien for Visual Art, Design, Photography and Media Art 2027 (BMWKMS) (closes 31 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Austrian Federal Ministry for Arts and Culture (BMWKMS)
Deadline: 31 Jan 2027
Award: 23 grants of EUR 9,000 for six months, plus EUR 200 per month for single parents or families on increased family allowance (EUR 400 if both apply). No application fee.

Start-up grants from the Austrian arts ministry for emerging artists, with media art as one of four named disciplines alongside visual art, design and photography (apply in one discipline only).

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: OCA International Support, February 2027 round (travel and production support for Norway-based artists abroad) (closes 3 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Office for Contemporary Art Norway (OCA)
Deadline: 3 Feb 2027, 23:59 CET
Award: Travel support and production support; the 2026 budgets were NOK 2,300,000 (travel) and NOK 3,200,000 (production) across three rounds. No per-grant figure published. No application fee.

OCA administers Norwegian state funds that help Norway-based art practitioners present work abroad. Travel support covers travel costs; production support covers making work for an international exhibition or project.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Creative Europe MEDIA: TV and Online Content 2027 (lump sums of EUR 70,000 to 2 million for fiction, animation and documentary production) (closes 10 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Creative Europe MEDIA (European Commission / EACEA)
Deadline: 10 Feb 2027, 17:00 CET
Award: Fixed lump sum set by total production budget: EUR 70,000 (budget up to EUR 500,000) rising through EUR 150,000, 300,000 and 500,000 to EUR 1 million (budget over EUR 10 million) and EUR 2 million (budget over EUR 20 million). Total call budget EUR 23,300,000 (animation 5.8 million, documentary 1.9 million, fiction 15.6 million). No application fee.

The MEDIA TV and Online Content call (CREA-MEDIA-2027-TVONLINE) funds the production of high-quality, innovative TV works and serial storytelling for linear and online release, made by independent European production companies with strong potential to circulate across Europe and beyond.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Cultural Bridge 2027-28, Round 6: UK-Germany partnerships in social and community arts (up to GBP 30,000) (closes 10 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Cultural Bridge (British Council, Goethe-Institut, Fonds Soziokultur and the four UK arts councils)
Deadline: 10 Feb 2027, 12:00 GMT
Award: Up to GBP 30,000 per partnership plus access costs, from a GBP 360,000 pot (about 12 awards). No application fee.

Cultural Bridge funds partnerships between UK and German arts organisations working in social and community arts practice. Round 6 is limited to established (Tier 2) partnerships with a track record of working together.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Creative Europe MEDIA: Audience Development and Film Education 2027 (up to 70 percent of costs, EUR 7 million call) (closes 2 Mar 2027)
item.description:
Creative Europe MEDIA (European Commission / EACEA)
Deadline: 2 Mar 2027, 17:00 CET
Award: Grant of up to 70 percent of total project costs; no fixed maximum per project given in the summary. Total call budget EUR 7,000,000, with about 15 projects expected. No application fee.

The MEDIA Audience Development and Film Education call (CREA-MEDIA-2027-AUDFILMEDU) funds projects that build public interest in, and knowledge of, European films and audiovisual works, including a dedicated strand for film heritage.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Creative Europe MEDIA: European Film Sales 2027 (up to EUR 800,000 for sales agents; opens 29 April 2027) (closes 17 Jun 2027)
item.description:
Creative Europe MEDIA (European Commission / EACEA)
Deadline: 17 Jun 2027, 17:00 CEST
Award: Up to EUR 800,000 per project, co-financing up to 70 percent of eligible costs. The amount is generated from cinema and online admissions sold in 2026 for the agent's European films. Total call budget EUR 6,000,000. No application fee.

European Film Sales (CREA-MEDIA-2027-FILMSALES) is automatic, performance-based support for sales agents handling recent non-national European films on all platforms. The call opens for applications on 29 April 2027.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Awesome Foundation Local Chapters: USD 1,000 Monthly Micro-grants (US, UK, Canada, Australia, NL, Asia) (rolling)
item.description:
Awesome Foundation (local chapters)
Deadline: Rolling, apply any time
Award: Usually USD 1,000 (or local equivalent) per grant, no strings attached, typically one grant per chapter per month. No application fee.

The Awesome Foundation is a network of volunteer giving circles: in each chapter about ten trustees pool their own money to give a USD 1,000 no-strings micro-grant, usually monthly, to a project that adds "awesome" to their area: art, public interventions, community tech, events, science and civic...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Kimonos Art Center: Episkeptes Residency, 5th edition (Cyprus; up to EUR 1,250 stipend) (closes 16 Nov)
item.description:
Kimonos Art Center
Deadline: 16 Nov 2026
Award: Up to EUR 1,250 stipend plus up to EUR 250 travel. EUR 25 application fee.

Kimonos Art Center's Episkeptes residency hosts three international visual artists, including video and multimedia artists, for one month, ending with a public presentation. ELIGIBILITY: international visual artists. OFFER: up to EUR 1,250 stipend and up to EUR 250 travel.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: ETC Digital Theatre Programme: Research and Development Sprints 2027-28 (cross-border theatre and digital artist teams) (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
European Theatre Convention (ETC) with the Akademie für Theater und Digitalität, Dortmund
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 3,000 development grant shared between the two partner theatres, plus up to EUR 2,860 from ETC for the Digital Expert's travel, accommodation and subsistence. The theatres must put the Digital Expert on their payroll at their usual creative fee. No application fee.

ETC's Digital Theatre Programme pairs two member theatres from different countries with a Digital Expert to research and develop artistic uses of technology in theatre: motion capture, coding, mixed, augmented and virtual reality, robotics and interaction design.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Titanik A.i.R x Sodas 2123: two-month sound art residency in Turku, Finland, for Lithuania-based artists (EUR 1,000 stipend, travel and housing) (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
Sodas 2123 (Vilnius) and Titanik A.i.R / Arte ry (Turku)
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026
Award: Stipend of EUR 1,000, travel expenses covered, free accommodation (25 m2 studio apartment) and a 20 m2 working studio. Food, local transport, materials and insurance are the resident's own cost. No application fee stated.

An exchange residency between Sodas 2123 (Vilnius) and Titanik (Turku), the only sound art residency in Finland. WHO: emerging and established artists based in Lithuania working in sound and sonic practices, or where sound meets performance and/or digital media; solo artists or duos.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: H401 WONDER open call: 4-week artist residency in Amsterdam on women in the European Resistance (EUR 3,000 fee plus production budget) (closes 6 Dec)
item.description:
H401 (Stichting Herengracht 401), within the EU-funded WONDER project led by ECCOM
Deadline: 6 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: Artist fee of EUR 3,000, production costs reimbursed up to EUR 1,000, plus travel, accommodation (if applicable) and subsistence under EU travel guidelines. Travel and accommodation for the final event in Rome are also covered. No application fee stated.

Women Narratives during the European Resistance (WONDER) is a 15-month EU project (CERV programme) in five countries; each partner hosts one artist, and this is the Dutch call, for 1 artist.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Frankfurt Moves! Frankfurt LAB Residency Stipend 2027 (closes 7 Dec)
item.description:
Frankfurt LAB and KfW Stiftung
Deadline: 7 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: EUR 2,750 gross stipend per person (EUR 2,000 for the Frankfurt month, EUR 750 for the remote month), plus four weeks of accommodation, round-trip travel to Frankfurt and up to EUR 800 for artistic work expenses per person or team. No application fee.

Frankfurt Moves!, an initiative of KfW Stiftung run with the Frankfurt LAB (the production space shared by Ensemble Modern, Dresden Frankfurt Dance Company, Hessische Theaterakademie, HfMDK Frankfurt and Mousonturm), offers four two-step residencies for emerging performing artists, solo or in teams...

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Petrides Residency for a Greek Artist in NY (NYFA x ISCP): funded three-month Brooklyn studio residency (USD 9,000 stipend) (closes 8 Dec)
item.description:
New York Foundation for the Arts (NYFA) with sculptor George Petrides and the International Studio & Curatorial Program (ISCP)
Deadline: 8 Dec 2026, 17:00 EST
Award: Fully funded three-month residency with a private studio, a USD 9,000 stipend, a USD 1,000 travel payment and up to USD 300 for professional development. Housing is not arranged by ISCP. No application fee stated.

NYFA, sculptor George Petrides and the International Studio & Curatorial Program (ISCP) offer one Greek artist a fully funded three-month studio residency in Brooklyn.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Planetary Transitions 2027: Potsdam Artist Residency (EUR 2,500/month, 4 to 6 months at a sustainability research institute) (closes 7 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Research Institute for Sustainability (RIFS) at GFZ, with the City of Potsdam and the DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program
Deadline: 7 Feb 2027
Award: Monthly stipend of EUR 2,500, plus a lump sum for travel to Potsdam and back, and up to EUR 5,000 housing support if you stay in Potsdam. No application fee stated.

An art-science residency that brings an international artist into the Research Institute for Sustainability (RIFS) in Potsdam to work alongside researchers on sustainability and planetary transitions. Run since 2025 by RIFS at GFZ, the City of Potsdam and the DAAD Artists-in-Berlin Program.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Saari Residence 2028 (Kone Foundation, Finland; monthly grant plus housing and workspace) (closes 31 Mar 2027)
item.description:
Kone Foundation, Saari Residence
Deadline: 31 Mar 2027, 16:00 EEST
Award: Monthly grant for living, travel and other costs, plus accommodation and workspace. The 2028 figure is not yet published; the 2027 cycle paid EUR 2,700, 3,200 or 3,800 per month depending on career stage. No application fee.

Saari Residence is the Kone Foundation's residency in rural southwest Finland, applied for a year in advance. Residents get housing, a workspace and a monthly grant (EUR 2,700 to 3,800 per month in the 2027 cycle, depending on career stage; 2028 figures not yet published).

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Schloss Wiepersdorf Individual and Collaborative Fellowships 2028 (Brandenburg; EUR 1,200/month plus room and board) (closes 15 Apr 2027)
item.description:
Schloss Wiepersdorf (state of Brandenburg)
Deadline: 15 Apr 2027, 23:59 CEST
Award: EUR 1,200 per month stipend, a one-time EUR 480 material grant, room and board, and German visa costs where needed. No application fee.

Three-month residential fellowships at Schloss Wiepersdorf for artists, writers, composers and scholars from Germany and abroad. Fellows get room, board, a EUR 1,200 monthly stipend and a material grant; fine artists get a studio where space allows.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: KB Fellowship at NIAS 2027-2028 (National Library of the Netherlands collections incl. born-digital; artists and researchers) (closes 15 Mar 2027)
item.description:
NIAS-KNAW (Netherlands Institute for Advanced Study) with the KB, National Library of the Netherlands
Deadline: 15 Mar 2027, 12:00 CET
Award: Personal stipend (figure not published); scholars at Dutch institutions get a Dutch University Grant paid to their institution instead. Office, subsidised Amsterdam housing where eligible (otherwise local transport reimbursement). No application fee.

One fellowship a year for work with the KB's collections, facilities and expertise, including its large digitised and born-digital holdings.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Weizenbaum Institute: Affiliated Fellowship with a research group (Berlin; EUR 3,000 to 5,000/month, rolling)
item.description:
Weizenbaum Institute for the Networked Society
Deadline: Rolling, apply any time
Award: Monthly allowance of EUR 3,000 (doctoral), EUR 4,000 (postdoc incl. assistant/associate professors) or EUR 5,000 (professors); EUR 2,500 / 3,500 if salary continues. Plus EUR 500/month child allowance and a travel lump sum of EUR 200 (Germany), 500 (Europe) or 1,200 (outside Europe). No application fee.

Short guest fellowships embedded in Weizenbaum Institute research groups working on platforms, digital society, AI and technology. ELIGIBILITY: researchers from doctoral candidates upward; artists are not mentioned.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Jane Street Graduate Research Fellowship 2027 (tuition plus USD 50,000 stipend) (closes 13 Nov)
item.description:
Jane Street
Deadline: 13 Nov 2026
Award: Full tuition and fees for the award year plus a USD 50,000 stipend (or local-currency equivalent; taxable). Finalists receive USD 5,000. No application fee.

Jane Street's Graduate Research Fellowship supports exceptional doctoral students in electrical engineering and computer science, mathematics, physics or statistics; research does not need to relate to trading.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: ARCAthens: Athens Residency Fellowships (Spring 2027) (closes 14 Nov)
item.description:
ARCAthens
Deadline: 14 Nov 2026, 23:00 EST
Award: Fully funded: housing, travel, a Fellowship Prize and a weekly stipend (most recent published terms, Fall 2026: USD 3,000 Fellowship Prize and USD 200/week stipend, round-trip airfare reimbursed). No application fee.

The Athens Residency is the flagship program of ARCAthens, a not-for-profit founded in 2017, offering fully funded Fellowships for visual artists and curators to live and work in Athens.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Democracy Foundation: Democracy Residency 'European Dream' 2027 (Kuldiga, Latvia; Liepaja European Capital of Culture) (closes 15 Nov)
item.description:
Democracy Foundation (Kuldiga), part of the Liepaja 2027 European Capital of Culture programme
Deadline: 15 Nov 2026
Award: EUR 1,000 stipend per participant (covering expenses during the residency, including travel), plus up to EUR 1,000 per participant to develop and run their activity, and accommodation in Kuldiga's Old Town. Six participants. No application fee stated.

International interdisciplinary residency run by the Democracy Foundation in Kuldiga, Latvia, as part of the Liepaja 2027 European Capital of Culture programme.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Horizons Arts-Nature en Sancy 2027: Open Call for Ephemeral In Situ Artworks (21st edition) (closes 30 Nov)
item.description:
Sancy Tourist Office (Office de Tourisme du Sancy)
Deadline: 30 Nov 2026, 09:00 CET
Award: EUR 8,000 (all taxes included) per selected artist or group: EUR 6,500 artistic costs and EUR 1,500 royalties (recommended proportion), travel costs included. 10 works commissioned. No application fee mentioned.

The 21st edition of Horizons Arts-Nature en Sancy, an open-air art exhibition in the Massif du Sancy (Auvergne, France) running 19 June to 26 September 2027.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Mophradat New Agents 2027: collective curatorial program (USD 6,000 stipend, Arab world) (closes 6 Dec)
item.description:
Mophradat
Deadline: 6 Dec 2026
Award: USD 6,000 stipend per participant, to use at their discretion, paid 2,500 / 2,500 / 1,000. Mophradat also covers retreat travel and a budget for the public event. Number of participants not stated (a small group). No application fee stated.

New Agents brings a small group of art practitioners (artists, curators and researchers) together for ten months to co-develop and realise a public event, such as a conference, festival or exhibition, that foregrounds the collective curatorial experience rather than the participants' individual...

item.description:
Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie (with LKCA and DEN)
Deadline: 16 Dec 2026, 15:00 CET
Award: EUR 10,000 to EUR 25,000 per project, up to 100% of total project costs (no co-funding required). Total budget EUR 500,000.

Open call (Open Oproep Cultuureducatie en Digitale Technologie) for cultural education projects in which children and young people work creatively with digital technology. Run by the Fonds voor Cultuurparticipatie with LKCA and DEN.

item.description:
2200
Deadline: 31 Dec 2026
Award: CHF 500 monthly stipend (about CHF 1,500 for a three-month stay), plus a studio and accommodation. Travel support negotiable. No application fee stated.

Residency giving emerging artists time and space away from their usual routine. Residents live and work on site in Switzerland for about three months on a project that grows out of the place.

item.title: Berlin Senate Work and Research Stipends 2027: Early Music, New Music and Sound Art (Klangkunst) (closes 12 Jan 2027)
item.description:
Senate Department for Culture and Social Cohesion, Berlin
Deadline: 12 Jan 2027, 14:00 CET
Award: EUR 12,000 work stipend or EUR 8,000 research stipend (number of awards not stated).

The Berlin Senate's annual stipends for professional musicians and sound artists living in Berlin, here in the early music, new music and sound art (Klangkunst) strand: a EUR 12,000 work stipend or a EUR 8,000 research stipend.

item.description:
Stiftung Kunstfonds
Deadline: 15 Jan 2027
Award: EUR 18,000 over 6 months. No application fee.

Working grant for professional freelance visual artists, media artists included, to concentrate on their practice for six months. The call opened 1 November 2026.

item.title: Netherland-America Foundation: Cultural Grant Program (1 February 2027 Cut-Off) (closes 1 Feb 2027)
item.description:
The Netherland-America Foundation (NAF)
Deadline: 1 Feb 2027
Award: Typically up to USD 5,000 per project, depending on scope and impact; higher amounts possible depending on available budget. No application fee.

The Netherland-America Foundation funds professional artistic and cultural projects that show a clear exchange between Dutch and American artists, institutions or audiences, such as exhibitions, performances and other cultural initiatives that promote dialogue and collaboration.

item.title: IJ4EU Freelancer Support Scheme 2026-27, Second Call (cross-border teams of freelance journalists) (closes 2 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Investigative Journalism for Europe (IJ4EU): International Press Institute and European Journalism Centre
Deadline: 2 Feb 2027
Award: Up to EUR 20,000 per team, plus training and mentoring.

A strand of IJ4EU for freelance journalists: teams of at least two freelancers in two eligible countries receive funding, training and mentoring for a cross-border investigation.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: IJ4EU Investigation Support Scheme 2026-27, Second Call (cross-border investigative journalism) (closes 2 Feb 2027)
item.description:
Investigative Journalism for Europe (IJ4EU): International Press Institute and European Journalism Centre
Deadline: 2 Feb 2027
Award: EUR 5,000 to 50,000 per project, from a EUR 1.2 million pot.

IJ4EU funds cross-border investigative journalism in the public interest, by teams of journalists and newsrooms working across at least two eligible countries. Eligibility is by country of residence, not citizenship; applications are in English.

European Research Executive Agency (REA) / European Commission, Horizon Europe

Two-stage open topic in the Horizon Europe Cluster 2 call 'Culture, Creativity and Inclusive Society - 2027 - Two-stage' (HORIZON-CL2-2027-02-DEMOCRACY-09-two-stage). Opens 2 March 2027; first-stage deadline 4 May 2027 (short proposal), with invited full proposals in a second stage.

European Research Executive Agency (REA) / European Commission, Horizon Europe

Award: DEMOCRACY-04: EUR 3.5 to 4.0 million per project, EUR 20 million indicative topic budget. DEMOCRACY-07: EUR 3.5 to 4.0 million per project, EUR 8 million indicative topic budget. Lump-sum Research and Innovation Actions.

Two 2027 topics in the Horizon Europe Cluster 2 call 'Culture, Creativity and Inclusive Society - 2027' (opens 13 May 2027, deadline 23 September 2027), both Research and Innovation Actions with lump-sum funding.

item.title: Culture Moves Europe: Call for Individual Mobility 2026-2027
item.description: Creative Europe (Culture Moves Europe), implemented by the Goethe-Institut · deadline 30 Apr 2027 · EUR 85 per day of project implementation, plus travel allowance of EUR 400 (under 5,000 km) or EUR 800 (from 5,000 km). Top-ups where applicable: green mobility EUR 400, overseas countries and territories / outermost regions EUR 175, family EUR 200 per child under 18, visa EUR 120. Accessibility support: EUR 30 per day plus actual cost or fixed allowance for personal assistance or sign language interpretation. No application fee.
